typical_models: 28 pickup variants (additive/multiplicative, classical/advanced) x time-series models
key_result: Additive beat multiplicative; advanced slightly beat classical; HW/STL best at 7 days and simple averages at 28-56 days.
transferable_idea: Shipment notices are bookings: forecast outbound with additive advanced pickup on the notice curve.
source_title: A Comparative Analysis of Pickup Forecasting Methods for Customer Arrivals in Airport Carparks (Papayiannis et al. 2016)

domain: Bed census prediction with expert discharge estimates
length_of_stay_analog: LOS distribution conditioned on physicians' estimated discharge dates
typical_models: Poisson binomial distribution + probabilistic convolution
key_result: Combining physician estimates with patient-statistics LOS distributions gives precise full census distributions on real data.
transferable_idea: Treat ERP/planner expected exit dates per pallet as 'expert estimates' and blend them with empirical dwell curves via Poisson-binomial sums.
source_title: Bed census prediction combining expert opinion and patient statistics (Bos et al. 2025)

domain: Hospital whole-house short-term census (by nursing unit and shift)
arrivals_analog: Scheduled elective admissions (= production plan) plus unscheduled admissions
length_of_stay_analog: Patient length of stay (= pallet dwell time)
typical_models: Patient-level statistical predictions aggregated to unit level; compared with other predictive methods
key_result: Second-generation model forecasts occupancy by unit and shift from individual-patient predictions and was evaluated on two years of hospital data (accuracy figures not on the abstract page).
transferable_idea: Forecast each cell class from item-level (pallet) predictions summed up, not from an aggregate occupancy series.
source_title: Short term hospital occupancy prediction (Isken & Littig 2007)
check_note: Independent check: corrected. IAOR record confirms the second-generation unit/shift occupancy model from patient-level predictions tested on 2 years of data, but the authors are Isken & Littig (Health Care Manag. Sci. 10(1), 2007).

domain: ICU occupancy management with patient-individual LOS
length_of_stay_analog: ML-predicted, expert-validated LOS distribution per patient
typical_models: Monte Carlo over individual LOS distributions
key_result: One year of 2019 data from a German ICU: a simple policy based on the probabilistic forecast would have avoided critical occupancy in about 70% of cases and smoothed occupancy.
transferable_idea: Give every pallet in stock its own exit-time distribution (plan-based where known, survival-based otherwise) and Monte Carlo the sum; let planners override distributions like clinicians do.
source_title: Monte-Carlo Simulation Based on Patient-Individual Distributions for Supporting Intensive Care Occupancy Management (Witteborg et al. 2022)

arrivals_analog: Patients from the master surgical schedule (= moulding/assembly plan)
length_of_stay_analog: Post-operative LOS distribution per patient type
typical_models: Exact analytical convolution of schedule x LOS distributions
key_result: Computes ward occupancy and admission/discharge distributions from the schedule; used to redesign the master surgical schedule at the Netherlands Cancer Institute.
transferable_idea: The production plan is the master schedule: convolve planned pallet output per block with dwell-time distributions to get the full occupancy distribution per class, then use it backwards to level the plan.
source_title: An exact approach for relating recovering surgical patient workload to the master surgical schedule (Vanberkel et al. 2011)

typical_models: Automatically generated online DES from live MES state; nightly 7-day and 35-day runs
key_result: Aggregated forecast accuracy >90% reached within three months; traffic-light display with last 3 days of history for plausibility.
transferable_idea: Closest industrial analogue: run the flow-balance simulator every morning from the 06:00 snapshot and show forecast-vs-actual for the last days.
source_title: Harmonizing Operations Management of Key Stakeholders in Wafer Fab Using DES (Seidel et al. 2017)

domain: Ward and ICU real-time occupancy forecasting (COVID-19)
typical_models: Network of time-varying infinite-server queues; 1,000-run Monte Carlo; mean and quantiles
key_result: ICU 95% prediction intervals covered realised occupancy in 74-97% of cases; three-day-ahead maximum-occupancy forecasts were most useful and were adopted in hospital dashboards.
transferable_idea: Report 'maximum occupancy in the next 2-3 days' per class with quantiles, and add parameter uncertainty or intervals will under-cover.
source_title: Real-time forecasting of COVID-19 bed occupancy in wards and Intensive Care Units (Baas et al. 2021)

typical_models: Piecewise linear regression with validation rules; time-to-full
key_result: Median R2 0.93; forecasts withheld for about 40-50% of systems on a typical day when validation failed.
transferable_idea: Alerts must be able to say 'I don't know' (e.g., after layout changes, data gaps) and report time-to-full rather than a bare fill ratio.
source_title: Capacity Forecasting in a Backup Storage Environment (Chamness, LISA 2011)

domain: Clinical wards with refused admissions under time-varying arrivals
arrivals_analog: Admissions with daily and weekly patterns
typical_models: M_t/H/s/s loss model with infinite-server approximations
key_result: Daily pattern had limited effect while the week-weekend pattern created large differences in refused admissions; higher LOS variability stabilised the time-dependent bed requirement.
transferable_idea: Refused admissions = pallets sent to the floor buffer: model day-of-week risk explicitly and treat the AW as a loss system near capacity.
source_title: Time-dependent analysis for refused admissions in clinical wards (Bekker & de Bruin 2010)

domain: Container dwell-time prediction with re-prediction on status updates
typical_models: ML with generative-AI standardisation of cargo/owner info; EDI status change triggers re-prediction
key_result: MAE improved 13.88% over models without standardised information; relocations cut by up to 14.68%.
transferable_idea: Re-predict each pallet's exit when its shipment notice or order status changes (event-triggered update of the residual-stock model).
source_title: Generative AI and Machine Learning Collaboration for Container Dwell Time Prediction (Kim et al. 2026)

arrivals_analog: Containers discharged on weekly vessel schedules
typical_models: Empirical yard-inventory analysis; static yard-space models
key_result: Weekly ship schedules create weekly yard-inventory cycles; even with steady cargo flows, longer dwell times grow inventory, so dwell time must be in yard capacity calculations.
transferable_idea: Coster's weekly rhythm (frozen plan every Wednesday, ~750 pallets shipped per week, month-end build-up) times dwell time drives occupancy; model both explicitly.
source_title: An empirical study on yard inventory change according to containers' dwell times (Kim & Youn 2013)

domain: Hotel room occupancy with advance bookings
typical_models: Pickup, exponential smoothing, moving average, Holt, regression
key_result: Exponential smoothing and pickup were the most robust; pickup minimised MAPE; authors recommend combining forecasts.
transferable_idea: Combine a pickup forecast of late notices with a smoothing baseline for flows without notices.
source_title: A comparison of forecasting methods for hotel revenue management (Weatherford & Kimes)

capacity_unit: Hospital and ICU beds per region
typical_models: Residual-LOS fitting + queueing theory
key_result: Models supported short-term patient-distribution decisions in the Netherlands and improved accuracy and trust in forecasts.
transferable_idea: Model residual dwell of pallets already stored separately from new arrivals.
source_title: Modeling COVID-19 hospital admissions and occupancy in the Netherlands (Bekker et al. 2023)

typical_models: M_t/G_t/inf with decomposition and parametric fitting
key_result: Daily occupancy often exceeded 100% of capacity even when long-run utilisation targets were met; static 85% rules performed poorly.
transferable_idea: Never set the 80/90% alert on averages; compute daily exceedance probabilities per class.
source_title: Data-Driven Bed Capacity Planning Using M_t/G_t/inf Queueing Models (Akbari-Moghaddam et al. 2025)
check_note: Independent check: confirmed. arXiv 2510.02852 confirms M_t/G_t/inf NICU model, daily occupancy often exceeding 100% even when long-run targets are met, and poor performance of static 85% rules.

typical_models: Arrivals-minus-departures model with capacity limit (TNL)
key_result: Test errors mostly below 4%; capacity-limit version far better where car parks fill; estimates cars that find no space.
transferable_idea: Add an explicit capacity/overflow term per class so the model outputs 'pallets turned away' instead of fill above 100%.
source_title: A simple and explainable model for park-and-ride car park occupancy prediction (Kaltenbrunner et al. 2025)

domain: Surgery schedule with multiple downstream units (ICU + wards)
typical_models: Stochastic analytical model for exact downstream demand distributions + exact/heuristic optimisation
key_result: Exact demand distribution on ICU and wards for a given block schedule; algorithms minimise downstream costs.
transferable_idea: Multiple downstream units = multiple cell classes fed by the same plan; compute class-specific distributions jointly.
source_title: Master surgery scheduling with consideration of multiple downstream units (Fugener et al. 2014)

typical_models: Two-level Gamma schedule generator + GreedyDwellFit vs Poisson
key_result: Poisson vessel arrivals misjudge waiting and yard occupancy; schedule-based generator reproduced throughput and call frequencies within 1% for Busan and Singapore.
transferable_idea: In the Monte Carlo, generate inflows from the plan plus slip noise, not as Poisson; production batches are lumpier than Poisson.
source_title: From Annual Throughput to Vessel Schedules: A Stochastic Generator for Transshipment Hub Simulation (Li et al. 2026)

typical_models: Time-varying queue; micro and macro real-time probabilistic predictors
key_result: Queue models validated on 29 sites over 16 months; prediction reduced to parameter estimation with a derived error lower bound.
transferable_idea: Use the micro view (each occupant's elapsed time -> residual duration) to forecast, and compute a lower bound to know when more modelling is pointless.
source_title: A Queuing Approach to Parking: Modeling, Verification, and Prediction (Tavafoghi et al. 2019)
check_note: Independent check: confirmed. arXiv 1908.11479 confirms time-varying queue, 29 truck parking sites, 16 months, 55-299 spots, micro/macro predictors, parameter-estimation reduction and a lower bound for any real-time predictor.

typical_models: Classical and advanced booking pickup vs time series and regression
key_result: Pickup models beat the others for demand under eight weeks before departure; advanced pickup best; more history often hurt.
transferable_idea: Use recent notice curves (short training windows), not long history, which also fits Coster's short comparable history.
source_title: Evaluation of forecasting techniques for short-term demand of air transportation (Wickham 1995)

typical_models: Deep DoS prediction (ParallelNet) + DoS-based storage assignment
key_result: 29% MAPE on DoS, about 30% better than CNN-LSTM; pilots reported up to 19-21% labour savings.
transferable_idea: DoS is predictable enough to drive slotting; for Coster, dwell prediction can also steer which class/aisle a pallet should take to cut defrag.
source_title: Duration-of-Stay Storage Assignment under Uncertainty (Li, Wolf & Wintz, ICLR 2020)

typical_models: Classifiers + DES evaluation (ExtendSim)
key_result: Class accuracy was low (best ~7.2%), yet segregation reduced rehandles about 17% in Jan-Apr 2012.
transferable_idea: Externally driven exits are hard to predict individually; aggregate or class-level dwell is still useful, and plan-driven exits should dominate where available.
source_title: A Dwell Time-based Container Positioning Decision Support System at a Port Terminal (Gaete et al. 2017)

length_of_stay_analog: LOS varying by hour of week
typical_models: MT_t/GI_t/inf data-driven aggregate model
key_result: A time-invariant LOS model missed a departure surge before midnight and misstated occupancy; LOS varying by hour of week matched occupancy closely.
transferable_idea: Let dwell distributions depend on entry weekday and month-end, since shipments cluster in time.
source_title: A Data-Driven Model of an Emergency Department (Whitt & Zhang 2016)

domain: Hospital digital twin for short-term bed occupancy (NHS)
typical_models: Simulation digital twin projecting occupancy under intervention scenarios
key_result: Feasibility project (Apr-Sep 2024) at University Hospital Southampton; no results on page.
transferable_idea: Pair the occupancy forecast with scenario runs (what-if) in the same tool.
source_title: PUNDIT - Predicting hospital Usage Numbers via a DIgital Twin (NIHR ARC Wessex)

arrivals_analog: Reservation requests allocated by discrete-choice model
typical_models: Simulation of requests + departure estimation + availability forecast
key_result: Small average errors on real data; accuracy improves as actual arrivals and departures are recorded.
transferable_idea: Allocation choice across facilities is like the cascade across cell classes; update forecasts intraday as movements post.
source_title: Prediction of parking space availability in real time (Caicedo et al. 2012)

domain: Pedestrian density in a station concourse
capacity_unit: People in a service area (density limit)
typical_models: Online simulation with parent-model synchronisation and child forecast runs
key_result: Synchronised initialisation better than direct model generation; forecasts vary across seeds; correction rules must be model-specific.
transferable_idea: Synchronise a 'parent' state model with every snapshot/movement and spawn forecast runs from it; correct unmeasured state against measured totals.
source_title: Initialization of Online Simulation Models (Hanisch et al. 2005)

domain: Terminal operator dwell-time ML in production (HHLA Hamburg)
departures_analog: Pick-up by truck, train or ship
typical_models: ML forecasts integrated into slot allocation
key_result: Deployed at CTA and CTB with 'a significant positive effect' (fewer moves); no figures given.
transferable_idea: Feed dwell predictions into the allocation rule (e.g., which class/aisle) as well as into the occupancy forecast.
source_title: HHLA to predict container dwell time with machine learning solutions (Port Technology)

domain: Third-party logistics warehouse fed by two factories
typical_models: AnyLogic agent-based + DES forecasting model
key_result: 3-month horizon with Excel inputs for inventory state, inbound, outbound and product matrix; quantitative results not yet available.
transferable_idea: Same input contract as Coster's Excel exports: snapshot + inbound + outbound + item master is enough to start.
source_title: Developing a Forecasting Simulation Model for Efficient Warehouse Operations (AnyLogic case study)

typical_models: Integrated vs sequential integer programs for scheduling and door assignment
key_result: Storage capacity assumed unlimited; storage use only penalised; integrated model up to 6.5% better but slow.
transferable_idea: Warning: many scheduling models ignore storage capacity; Coster's later scheduling must include class capacities explicitly.
source_title: Integrated Versus Sequential Scheduling and Assignment at a Unit Load Cross-Dock (Rijal, Bijvank & de Koster)
